kit.logo.primary_p: The {kind} is the primary logo. Use it wherever the space allows; every other version is derived from it.
kit.logo.kept_p: It is the existing logo, kept as supplied.
kit.logo.clear_p: Keep at least x = {mult} × {unit} free on every side.
kit.logo.inferred: (inferred from the drawing; confirm before print)
kit.logo.rule1: Use the supplied files in kit/logo; never retype or redraw the wordmark.
kit.logo.rule3: The guide lines show the cap height and baseline the lockup is aligned on.
kit.var.primary_p: Horizontal lockup. The default for headers, documents and signage.
kit.var.stacked_p: For square and narrow spaces where the horizontal lockup gets too small.
kit.var.symbol_p: On its own only where the brand is already named nearby: avatars, app icons.
kit.var.favicon_p: The symbol on the primary colour at 48, 32 and 16 px.
kit.var.one_p: For single-colour print, embossing and stamps.
kit.var.reversed_p: On dark grounds and photographs, in one light colour.
kit.var.on_primary_p: On the primary colour, in its on-colour; for covers and large brand moments.
kit.var.side_small: Pick the version by the space, not by taste. When the primary logo would render smaller than {px} px tall, switch to the symbol.
kit.var.side_nosmall: Pick the version by the space, not by taste. When the primary logo would render smaller than {px} px tall, the logo stops reading; give it more room instead.
kit.onc.lede: Every logo part keeps at least 3:1 against its ground. Where the colours cannot, the logo switches to one colour.
kit.misuse.rearrange: Don't rearrange the symbol and the name
kit.col.side: Band heights show how much of each colour a typical page uses. Large areas take the ground and primary; the accent stays small.
kit.col.print_p: Screen values are exact. For print, ask your printer for CMYK/Pantone matches made with their profile; the Lab D50 values are the reference to match against.
kit.col.tints_p: 80, 50 and 20% for charts and backgrounds only, never for text.
kit.app.name: Name Surname
kit.grid.p: Headlines start on column 1; body copy runs 5 to 7 columns wide. Big titles may hang into the margin by their side bearing only.
kit.icons.r1: 24 px grid, 2 px padding, 1.75 px stroke.
kit.icons.r2: Round caps and joins; no fills except for a selected state.
kit.icons.r3: Icons take the ink or primary colour, never the accent.
kit.icons.r4: Sample set shown in the system style; draw new icons to match.
kit.imagery.r1: Real people, real places; natural light.
kit.imagery.r2: Duotone in the primary and ink for backgrounds behind text.
kit.imagery.r3: The accent appears in pictures only where it already exists in the scene.
kit.imagery.r4: No stock clichés: no handshakes, no glowing orbs.
kit.dark.p: In dark mode the ground is {bg}; text and the primary move to their dark-mode steps. The logo uses the {version} version.
kit.access.p: Body text needs 4.5:1, large text and logo parts 3:1 (WCAG 2.2). Every pair shown here is measured from the palette.
kit.fonts.title: fonts
kit.fonts.intro: Font files are not part of this kit. Get them from the source below under their licence.
kit.fonts.commercial: Commercial fonts: check that your licence covers web, app and PDF embedding.
swatch.title: swatches
swatch.heading: Heading on surface
swatch.note: Contrast: WCAG 2.x ratios, unrounded. Lab D50 values are computed from sRGB for print hand-off; CMYK needs the printer's ICC profile and Pantone matches need a physical guide.
swatch.generated: Generated by brand-identity from palette.json. Edit the palette, not this file.
